preconditions.description: The lengths of strings A and B must be positive integers within the range of 1 to 5000.
The length of string A must equal n and the length of string B must equal m.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in A) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B must consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximal similarity score calculated from all pairs of substrings of A and B.
